integrity: Exact all-parameter proof via Kummer carries and a finite closed two-step reachable-state certificate; checker.py reconstructs the finite certificate and adds numerical regression tests, not an independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the fixed first parameter four and gives first failure only, not subsequent failures. Historical priority beyond the inspected primary sources remains uncertain.
title: Exact first nondivisibility indices in the fourfold binomial family
